name: OR-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Salinas is an incumbent in a district with a +6 Democratic lean
David Russ has raised only ~$13k with $21 on hand, no outside support
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~95%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Salinas: a +6 Democratic district, incumbency, and a large fundraising edge against a challenger with essentially no money. Markets price this at roughly 95% Democratic, so a Safe D call with a slightly trimmed margin accounts for the absence of polling.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or a polling surprise showing Russ competitive would warrant revisiting, but no such evidence exists yet.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Andrea Salinas seeks a second term in a district that leans Democratic by about six points. She has raised over $1.6 million and holds more than $600,000 on hand, while Republican David Russ has raised roughly $13,000 with just $21 in cash and no outside spending on either side. No independent groups are opposing the incumbent.

With no general-election polls and no expert ratings, the race rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win near 95%. The combination supports a Safe Democratic rating, with a modest haircut to the expected margin given the lack of direct polling.
